17:52 Local Time, 15:52 GMT, 21:22 IST: Huge win for SA. The hosts were never in the game once the visitors slammed 348. They were always behind the 8-ball. There were two rain breaks and that delayed the victory for SA as the win looked inevitable. Namibia never threatened with the bat. Even with the ball, barring the first few overs, SA had it in control. The 150 from Hermann on debut at the top had set it up for the visitors. They never put a foot wrong. Namibia added 50 runs for the first wicket but took too much time in doing so. Kudos to the groundsmen as well. They were relentless. They just kept going to ensure there was play possible after the first rain break. Lot of food for thought for the Namibian side. They will have to come back stronger from this massive loss.

Bjorn Fortuin: It’s nice to get a good start to the ODI series. It’s really nice to see the guys standing up again. Jordan played an unbelievable knock, and Tony got some nice momentum as well. I hope we can keep going. Yeah, I think performing well for your team is what you want to do. What happens after that isn’t really in our control as players. But it’s nice to see the guys performing, especially performing big, like Jordan did today. That’s a good culture to build within a young team.
